grammar_focus: 并列句与并列连词(主考:and/but/so/or 连接两个简单句 · both A and B 两者都 · either A or B 二者选一 · neither A nor B 两者都不 · not only A but also/as well B 不但…而且)+ the English 群体名词用复数 / at last(辅考)
scene: 初到伦敦,火车站又黑又暗;向搬运工问路,自己说得又慢又清楚他却听不懂,他回话又快又含糊——我这才发现:英国人彼此听得懂,我却听不懂他们,他们说的到底是不是英语?

grammar_card.title: 把两个简单句连起来(并列连词)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么用连词把两个简单句连成并列句:and(和)、but(但)、so(所以)、or(或),还有成对的 both…and、either…or、neither…nor、not only…but also。全用本课句子举例。

rows: and 顺接 / but 转折 / so 因果 / or 选择
He finished lunch and went into the garden.
He is both tall and strong.
either A or B:二者选一;neither A nor B:两者都不
He spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
not only A but also/as well B:不但…而且
I spoke not only carefully but clearly as well.

specialRules.rule: people 作主语永远用复数动词:British/American/Chinese people like tea. 文化卡:the English = English people(书面/正式),口语常说 British people。
at last = 终于、最后:I arrived in London at last.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why does the writer not understand the porter?
options: The porter spoke neither slowly nor clearly, unlike the teacher's English
The porter said nothing at all

passage: I arrived in London at last. The train station was big, black, and dark. I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter. I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well. The porter, however, could not understand me. I repeated my question several times, and at last he understood. He answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly. 'I am a foreigner,' I said. Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him. My teacher never spoke English like that! The porter and I looked at each other and smiled. Then he said something and I understood it. 'You'll soon learn English!' he said. I wonder. In England, each person seems to speak a different language. The English understand each other, but I don't understand them! Do they speak English?
